meta.title: HAZOP and LOPA of the RDC-V1 unit
meta.scope: From the feed receipt into T-101 (HIC-117) through the feed pumps P-101A/B, FV-101 and the cooler E-101, and from the solvent drum D-102 (N₂ blanket, return HIC-118) through P-102A/B, FV-103 and E-102, to the rotating-disc contactor C-101 with its rotor M-101, PSV-108, the raffinate line (PV-108, HV-108) to the stripper C-102 and the extract line (LV-109, XV-119) to the solvent recovery column C-103; the SIS and the procedures.
meta.objective: Identify the hazards and operability problems of the unit, judge their risk, and decide what must be added or changed. For the scenarios that need more than the existing safeguards, check the risk reduction by LOPA.
meta.assump: The unit is operated by trained staff at the design conditions (1000 kg/h feed, solvent ratio 0.35, 180 rpm, 25 °C, 1.0 bar g). Instrument air, chilled water, N₂ and power are available at start-up. Instruments and the relief valve are tested on the plan in the maintenance procedure.
meta.protocol: Method: HAZOP to IEC 61882 with full recording. The team takes one node at a time, states its design intent, and applies the guide words to each parameter to find deviations. For each deviation it records the causes, the events that follow, the consequences without credit for safeguards, the existing safeguards, and the risk after safeguards (S × L). Rows above the tolerable level go to LOPA in the same worksheet: initiating-event frequency, enabling conditions and conditional modifiers, independent protection layers with their PFD, and the mitigated frequency compared with the tolerable event likelihood for the severity. Open points go to the Parking Lot; actions become recommendations with an owner and a due date.

N5.causes:
Raffinate outlet blocked: PV-108 drifts shut, PV-108 closed in MAN, downstream valve closed
thermal expansion when blocked in
N5.cons: Pressure reaches pump shut-off (about 5 bar g): flange or shell failure, release of flammable and toxic liquid

ie.d: PV-108 or its positioner fails closed
PIC-108 loop fails low (PT-108 reads low) and closes PV-108
Downstream block valve closed in error with the unit running

N5.causes:
Feed and solvent stop
PV-108 fails open (air failure)
N5.cons: Column drains toward C-102; dissolved gas or vapour; interface upset

N5.causes:
Chilled water lost with a hot feed
bearing friction
N5.cons: Acetone vapour forms at the top; pressure rises; extraction poorer

N5.dev: Interface falls toward the extract outlet
N5.causes:
LT-109 reads high (LIC-109 lowers the real interface)
LV-109 sticks open
N5.cons: Aqueous phase leaves with the extract to C-103; in the dynamic run the real interface reached about 5 % with LI-109 showing about 92 %

N5.dev: Interface rises into the active zone
N5.causes:
LV-109 closed or stuck
LT-109 reads low
emulsion band
N5.cons: Extract carried into the raffinate outlet; TCE loss (AI-113 up)

N5.causes:
SIC-105 set point too high
bearing wear
coupling problem
N5.cons: Fine drops, flooding, emulsion; overload damages the drive

N5.causes:
VFD trip
coupling slip (discs slower than the tachometer)
N5.cons: Coarse drops, poor extraction; no safety hazard

N5.causes:
Feed and solvent both high
surfactant in the feed
N5.cons: Flooding: phases leave by the wrong outlets

N5.dev: Leak at the top shaft seal
N5.cons: Release of extract (flammable and toxic) at the column top; fire gives HCl and phosgene

N5.dev: Gas or air in the column
N5.causes:
Not vented at start-up
N₂ carried from D-102
N5.cons: Pressure surges, poor control, flammable pocket at the top

recs.text: Add an operating-window alarm on the flood approach (PDI-110 with FI-101 + FI-103)
LOPA for column overpressure; confirm the PSV-108 relief case (blocked outlet with both pumps at shut-off) and its discharge to a closed system
Consider a high-pressure override that closes FV-101 and FV-103 before PSHH-108
Confirm the design temperature of C-101 and the TSHH-106 set point against the acetone boiling point at the column pressure
Give LSLL-109 and LSHH-109 their own interface transmitter (LT-109B), independent of LIC-109
Add a disc-speed sensor on the shaft (not only the motor tachometer)
Seal leak detection on the rotor shaft seal; fire and toxic-smoke response plan
Write the fill-and-vent step with a check that liquid is at the vent
